posts.name: Ensign53
posts.cooked:
Just got the unlock vs Ambuscade. Followed the steps on Reddit.


* Have Akash'Thriya on your team
* Play in Nexus of the Void
* Get Akash'Thriya down to 1 HP, then back up to 50 HP
* Get the Akash'Flora in play and keep it alive, possibly using it to grant a power at least once
* Win the game
